reason: This gap aims to compare the sleep environments of infants who died from SUID versus those who died from other causes using a case-case study design within the NCFRP dataset. The rationale is sound as it seeks to directly assess differences in sleep environment variables, such as room-sharing with caregivers/supervisors, between these two groups of infant deaths. Prior studies have noted limitations and differences but do not provide direct comparisons between SUID and non-SUID cases regarding sleep environments.
